Name: Boat Horse - Content Patcher
Author: CatCattyCat
TagLine: Replaces your horse with a boat. Optionally replaces Tractor Mod's tractor with a boat too!
Description:
Boat Horse

![](https://i.imgur.com/29OIurw.gif)

This mod replaces your horse with a boat. It also has an optional download to change Tractor Mod's tractor also into a boat.

To install: simply drag the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.

To install the tractor replacement:

1.  Install [Tractor Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1401)  first

2.  Drag the folder into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder and let it overwrite tractor.png.
To uninstall the tractor replacement:

1.  Delete Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor.png

2.  Rename Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor_original.png to Stardew Valley/Mods/TractorMod/tractor.png
Requires [SMAPI](https://smapi.io) and [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) by Pathoschild

[Check out my other mods by clicking here!](https://www.nexusmods.com/users/44734342?tab=user+files)
